requirement:
Expandable coverage details contain current annotation explanations
and last recorded citation reviews. Test-run provenance and execution
measurements remain in saved artifacts rather than the generated book.
rationale: The subject has three obligations. I judged them against the two supplied tests and did not request implementation source. 1. **Current annotation explanations in the details.** `src/execution_coverage/check.rs#mod[tests]/fn[book_browses_all_proposals_while_cli_checks_reviews_and_measurements]` renders the "Documented coverage gaps" chapter. It asserts that the documented explanation "Invariant fallback, unreachable through the public API." appears, along with the source location and `fn[b]`. After the source is edited so the explanation is gone, it asserts that "No tracked justification is present." is shown. That shows the explanation follows the current source rather than a stale copy. 2. **Last recorded citation reviews in the details.** The same test asserts "Recorded review: Missing" when no review exists. It then records `true`, `false` and `{"FIXME": [...]}` and asserts "Recorded true", "Recorded false" and "Recorded FIXME" respectively. After the source changes, it asserts "Recorded true" is still shown and "citations changed" is not. That confirms the last recorded review is kept. 3. **No test-run provenance or execution measurements in the book; they stay in saved artifacts.** `src/execution_coverage/book.rs#mod[tests]/fn[book_ignores_saved_measurements_and_preserves_artifacts]` saves an attempt with a distinctive test name and a measurement. It asserts that the rendered chapters are identical to the render with no saved data, so the measurements have no effect on the book.
